# #[ignore]d tests that need root, which the rust_test job in
# .github/workflows/sami-rust-test.yml runs anyway: each alone, last, as root
# (`sudo -E`, outside linux-sandbox, which maps one uid), with `--ignored
# --exact <name>` and a 1200 s bound. The job fails unless each runs there
# (exactly that test, not still ignored), and when it fails, like any test.
# One per line: <bazel test target> <libtest test name>  <why it needs root>.
//crates/pi-builtins:pi-builtins_test rm::tests::force_reports_a_mount_point_it_cannot_remove  mounts a tmpfs on the directory rm -f must report busy (the test's `mount` command): #[ignore = "mounts a tmpfs; run as root with --ignored"]; without the mount nothing is busy and it would pass proving nothing (its doc comment)
//crates/pi-builtins:pi-builtins_test rm::tests::reports_a_directory_that_is_its_own_ancestor  bind-mounts a directory into itself to make a cycle rm must report
